Test is_not_found()-style matching rather substring search. premise Present read spec checked question's premise (premise = TRUE gr_read_spec()). NA model reported nothing document contradicting question; otherwise sentence said document states instead, answer well, is_not_found() FALSE. model's verdict, check harnessr made. Absent (NULL) spec ask, screen extract, answer question. partial Logical(1). TRUE anything degraded: call failed, chunks dropped, cap hit, strategy fell back, text cut fit, pages document never became text (scan read without OCR). Check trusting answer. notes List. partial, per-reader detail: dropped_chunks, failed_calls, error, merge_levels, degraded_to_bm25, stop_reason, call_cap_reached, cost_cap_reached, summaries_truncated, . Three can set every reader: cited_unknown, chunk ids answer cited never sent; unverified_evidence, number quoted spans chunk claim come ; unread_pages, pages never became text. makes answer partial. warnings Character. harnessr warned document ingested, cut read, named warning's class. warnings still print happen; copy stays answer, including document came ingestion cache nothing raised . evidence Data frame NULL, columns chunk_id, text, page, section, score, kind. text holds depends reader: verbatim chunk text stuff, retrieve, rerank iterative; model-extracted passages skim; per-chunk model answers map_reduce. refine hierarchical return NULL. page populated PDF sources; score retrieve (cosine) rerank (0-10, model-judged). evidence model-written (skim), three columns appear: source_text, chunk span claims quote, plus verified match checking one ; see gr_verify_evidence(). Readers whose evidence verbatim chunk text carry , span source string. kind says row holds ("verbatim", "extracted" "answer") per row, ensemble mixes . blank roxygen line inside \describe{} item ends item, one paragraph. chunks_used Integer vector chunk_ids CONTRIBUTED answer. per-chunk readers subset chunks sent: chunk answered NOT_IN_DOCUMENT read paid listed. notes$chunks reports many sent. reader, signature strategy ran, traversal signature (see gr_reader_signature()). question question, asked. trace gr_trace run. answer_document() holds whole run: ingestion, segmentation read. answer taken gr_compare() holds recipe's segmentation read (segmentation requests, semantic, proposition contextual context_source = "llm" bill, pre-flight check reader's requests), recipe counted apart. Ingestion recipes comparison's trace, cmp$trace: cost save one record comparison . trace passed trace = shared, copied: field trace , still holds every run recorded , one . trace_steps says steps run's. trace_steps Integer c(first, last): steps trace run made, NULL trace kept. as_json(), print() audit report (gr_audit_report()) use , answer read trace shared across runs carry runs' prompts, calls cost. recipe, document, segmentation Added answer_document() gr_compare(): recipe name, source ingestion stats, chunk statistics reader saw.

code: # Resolution order: explicit argument, then the option, then the env var. previous <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", unset = NA) Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-example") gr_api_key() #> [1] "sk-example" gr_api_key("sk-explicit-wins") #> [1] "sk-explicit-wins"  # With no key set it says so. A run stops the same way, before its first # request; see the section above. Sys.unsetenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") tryCatch(gr_api_key(), gr_auth_error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)) #> [1] "No API key. Set OPENAI_API_KEY, or options(harnessr.api_key = '...'), or pass `api_key` to gr_client()."  # Restore. Sys.setenv(x = NA) would leave the variable set to "NA", not unset. if (!is.na(previous)) Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY = previous)
